consequence.statement: The addition is purely additive read-only CLI capability; the release note states no change to existing resources, settings or behaviour, so an upgrading environment needs no action.

assertion.statement: flux 2.7.0 adds read-only commands for the ArtifactGenerator kind to the flux CLI.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence states that read-only flux CLI commands for the ArtifactGenerator kind were added, but it does not name the commands, and no subject family covers CLI commands/subcommands (cli-flag covers flags with a leading -- only).
